tutorial.declareControls: The declarer picks one trump suit. Choosing your longest suit usually gives the best advantage.
tutorial.trickDisplay: The current trick appears here. Follow the lead suit if possible — trumps beat any non-trump card.
tutorial.scoreTable: Score table: Aces and Jacks = 1pt, Tens = 10pt, last trick = +2 (50pt total). The declaring team needs 26 or more to make the contract.
tutorial.playButton: Pick a card from your hand and press Play to play it.
tutorial.resetButton: Reset the game and start over from the beginning.
